{{search|home videos|the song|Pikachu's Winter Vacation (song)}} [[File:Pikachu's Winter Vacation.png|thumb|200px|Pikachu's Winter Vacation logo]] [[File:Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2.png|thumb|200px|Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2 logo]] '''Pikachu's Winter Vacation''' is a series composed of several [[Pikachu short]]s that are related to winter and [[Christmas]]. There are three different sets of segments. ==Segments== * '''Pikachu's Winter Vacation''' ('''ピカチュウのふゆやすみ''') ** ''[[PK02|Christmas Night / Winter Vacation]]'' ** ''[[PK03|Kanga Games / Winter Games]]'' * '''Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2000''' or '''Pokémon Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2''' ('''ピカチュウのふゆやすみ2000''') ** ''[[PK05|Winter Games / Winter Vacation 2]]'' ** ''[[PK06|Stantler's Little Helpers]]'' * '''Pichu & Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2001''' ('''ピチューとピカチュウのふゆやすみ2001''') ** ''[[PK08|Delibird's Dilemma]]'' ** ''[[PK09|Snorlax Snowman]]'' ** ''[[Trouble in Big Town]]'' ==Release== {{incomplete|section|needs=Details on Japanese release}} In Japan, these segments were released on home video as {{wp|original video animation}}s. In the United States, the ''Pikachu's Winter Vacation'' segments were released as [[List of English language Pokémon animated special home video releases (Region 1)#Pikachu's Winter Vacation series|''Pokémon Pikachu's Winter Vacation'' on VHS]] in 1999; and the ''Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2000'' segments were released as [[List of English language Pokémon animated special home video releases (Region 1)#Pikachu's Winter Vacation series|''Pokémon Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2'' on VHS]] in 2000. All four of these segments were released in the United States [[List of English language Pokémon animated special home video releases (Region 1)#Pikachu's Winter Vacation series|on DVD]] on November 23, 2004. In the United Kingdom, the ''Pikachu's Winter Vacation'' and ''Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2000'' segments were released together as [[List of English language Pokémon animated special home video releases (Region 2)#Pokémon Pikachu's Winter Vacation|''Pokémon Pikachu's Winter Vacation'' on VHS]] in 2001. The ''Pikachu's Winter Vacation'' and ''Pichu & Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2001'' segments were also released as part of [[Pokémon Chronicles]]. * The ''Pikachu's Winter Vacation'' segments were combined into a single special episode, titled ''Pikachu's Winter Vacation'', and formed episode 22 of [[Pokémon Chronicles]]. * Two of the ''Pichu & Pikachu's Winter Vacation 2001'' segments (''[[PK08|Delibird's Dilemma]]'' and ''[[PK09|Snorlax Snowman]]'') were combined into a single special episode, also titled ''Pikachu's Winter Vacation'', and formed episode 4 of Pokémon Chronicles. * ''[[Trouble in Big Town]]'' aired as episode 20 of Pokémon Chronicles. ==In other languages== ''Pikachu's Winter Vacation'' {{langtable|color=E66650|bordercolor=FFF7A5 |sv=Pikachu's Winter Vacation{{tt|*|cover and text in the move}}
